def next_tolerable_string(n, p, s):
    # Convert the string to a list of characters for easier manipulation
    chars = list(s)
    
    # Define the allowed characters
    allowed_chars = [chr(ord('a') + i) for i in range(p)]
    
    # Start from the end of the string and try to increment each character
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        # Find the current character's index in the allowed characters
        current_index = allowed_chars.index(chars[i])
        
        # Try to increment the character
        if current_index < p - 1:
            # Increment the character
            chars[i] = allowed_chars[current_index + 1]
            
            # Ensure no palindrome of length 2 is formed
            if i > 0 and chars[i] == chars[i - 1]:
                continue
            
            # Make the rest of the string lexicographically smallest
            for j in range(i + 1, n):
                chars[j] = allowed_chars[0]
                if j > 0 and chars[j] == chars[j - 1]:
                    chars[j] = allowed_chars[1]
            
            # Check if the new string is tolerable
            if all(chars[j] != chars[j + 1] for j in range(n - 1)):
                return ''.join(chars)
    
    # If no valid string is found, return "NO"
    return "NO"
